# BillboardGui

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("BillboardGui")`

A tree of UI placed in the world and turned to face the camera: a name over a head, a health bar over a crate or a marker on an objective. Its children are laid out as in a `ScreenGui`, against a canvas of `Size`. It is drawn in the world, behind whatever is in front of it and under the scene's lighting, not over the picture.

It is placed over `Adornee`, or over its parent when the parent is a part and `Adornee` is nil. Its buttons work like those on screen: the pointer's ray finds them in the world, and a solid object in front blocks them unless `AlwaysOnTop` is on. A screen element at the same pixel takes the press first.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Adornee` | `(BasePart | Part2D)?` | — | read/write | The part the billboard is placed over: a part in the world, or a `Part2D` on the 2D plane. With nil, its parent is used if the parent is one of those. A billboard with neither is not drawn. |
| `AlwaysOnTop` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the billboard shows through walls. When it is off, objects in front of it hide it. |
| `Brightness` | `number` | `1` | read/write | A multiplier on the billboard's colors in the scene's lighting. Above 1 it glows and blooms. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the billboard is laid out and drawn. |
| `MaxDistance` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The distance from the camera, in meters, beyond which the billboard is not drawn. 0 means no limit. |
| `Size` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)` | read/write | The size of the billboard. The scale is in meters and the offset is in pixels. A scale keeps its size in the world, so the billboard shrinks with distance. An offset keeps its size on screen, so a name tag is as readable from far away as from nearby. Children are laid out against the size in pixels in both cases. |
| `WorldOffset` | `vector` | `vector.zero` | read/write | The position of the billboard's center relative to the center of the adornee, in meters along the world's axes. `vector.create(0, 3, 0)` is three meters above the part, however the part is rotated. |
